messages:
Maya Nguyen: FYI escalating — Acme (Carlos) reports ~200 customers seeing "promo_not_active" when applying promo codes. They say codes were sent out yesterday. Error comes back 400.

Carlos (Acme): repro steps I did: the web checkout calls POST /v1/promos/apply with code=ACME20, user_id=acct_742. Response: {\"error\":\"promo_not_active\",\"campaign_id\":\"cmp_9f2\"} — we definitely included ACME20 in the email.

Maya Nguyen: copy of the curl they sent:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/promos/apply \ 
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer sk_live_xxx' \ 
  -d '{"code":"ACME20","user_id":"acct_742","amount":0}'
```

Maya Nguyen: I checked promo-bot logs (attached) — first API return for that campaign is showing start_date: "2026-03-20T00:00:00Z" but marketing thought campaign started 2026-03-10.

Jin Park: that smells like a timezone off-by-one when the CSV import wrote dates without converting local timezone. Can you paste the campaign record from admin?

Maya Nguyen: admin dump for campaign cmp_9f2:
```
id: cmp_9f2
code: ACME20
start_date: 2026-03-20T00:00:00Z
end_date: 2026-04-20T23:59:59Z
redemption_limit_per_code: 1000
redemption_limit_per_account: 0
status: active
created_by: marketing@acme.com
```

Maya Nguyen: Marketing insists they clicked "Mar 10" in the UI. The CSV someone uploaded had dates in MM/DD/YYYY and the importer assumed UTC midnight for the parsed value — looks like their local timezone (PDT) conversion error moved it forward.

Priya Shah: we need two tracks: 1) immediate mitigation for affected customers (grant credits) 2) fix campaign record if it's safe. Also want a root-cause so it doesn't recur.

Malik Ortega: granting credits impacts billing reconciliation. How many customers affected?

Carlos (Acme): ~220 attempted to apply in the first 12h after send; about 60 got charged without discount before they aborted and reached out.

Maya Nguyen: proposed short-term: set a temporary override to force-activate cmp_9f2 (flag in admin) AND issue one-off promo grants for the 60 charged users. We can also backdate start_date to 2026-03-10T00:00:00Z if DB migration is safe.

Jin Park: quick checks:
1) Is there any dependency on start_date for billing batch that would break if we backdate?
2) Are redemption counters already incremented (i.e., did any redemptions exceed per-code limits)?

Maya Nguyen: redemption counters: SQL query results (sanitized):
```
SELECT redemption_count, account_id FROM promo_redemptions WHERE campaign_id='cmp_9f2' LIMIT 5;
-- rows: (5, acct_101), (2, acct_742), (0, acct_555) ... total_redemptions: 180
```

Jin Park: total_redemptions 180 < redemption_limit_per_code 1000 so backdating should not violate limits. Billing side: Malik?

Malik Ortega: If we backdate, invoices generated for those 60 charges will need adjustments. We can't retroactively change invoice lines without a billing-reconciliation ticket. I'm ok with a targeted credit issuance to the 60 users instead of messing with issued invoices.

Priya Shah: OK prioritize customer goodwill: Maya, please issue credits for the 60 charged users and record XREF ticket in billing. Jin — can you prepare the safe DB change to update start_date and add a validation to the CSV importer to interpret dates with explicit timezone or warn on ambiguous formats?

Jin Park: Will do. Proposed DB ALTER (preview):
```
BEGIN TRANSACTION;
UPDATE promo_campaigns SET start_date='2026-03-10T00:00:00Z' WHERE id='cmp_9f2';
-- double-check replicas and cache invalidation
COMMIT;
```
I'll add a migration that logs old vs new values and ensures no overlapping campaigns for same code.

Maya Nguyen: action items:
- Maya: create support ticket list + issue one-off credits to 60 users (pending billing approval).
- Malik: open billing reconciliation ticket for invoice adjustments (ref BR-2026-117).
- Jin: prepare DB update patch and CSV importer validation PR.
- Priya: notify marketing and confirm they want backdate + change review.

Carlos (Acme): appreciate the fast follow-up. Can you also whitelist future sends so promo-bot doesn't reject queued emails if we toggle start_date?

Maya Nguyen: noted. I'll coordinate with infra to ensure promo-bot caches are invalidated.

Jin Park: quick note — there is a failing unit test in promo importer stack around ambiguous dates, I'll push a fix, but won't deploy to prod until we coordinate with marketing.

Priya Shah: please keep this thread updated with each step. Also add a doc in /support/incidents with timeline + customer-facing message.

Maya Nguyen: will do. Initial customer message draft: "We're sorry — due to an import timezone mismatch the ACME20 promo was not live for several customers. We've issued refunds/credits to affected customers and activated the campaign retroactively. We're also adding an importer validation to avoid recurrence."

promo-bot: Automated note: campaign cmp_9f2 flagged for manual review by support at 2026-03-15T10:06:00Z.

Maya Nguyen: closing loop — credits issued to first 60 users (txn ids logged), billing ticket BR-2026-117 opened, Jin opened PR #2567 for importer validation. Pending DB change approval from security for migration.

Priya Shah: thanks team. Follow-up meeting in 30m to confirm DB change window and customer comms.
